stories.headline: Restoring oyster reefs could deliver $12 trillion in benefits
stories.summary: About 85% of oyster reefs vanished in a century. A Tsinghua University study estimates that fully restored reefs in 10 countries would provide $12 trillion of clean water, carbon storage and coast protection.
stories.why: Oysters filter water and shield coasts, and there's room to bring them back.

stories.headline: Aarhus now heats 1,900 homes with water from its bay
stories.summary: Six seawater heat pumps on the Aarhus harbour front draw up to 1.2 million litres an hour and turn it into district heating for about 1,900 homes. Eight more are due from 2028.
stories.why: Cold seawater is replacing wood pellets as the city's heat source.

stories.headline: Yarning circles help preschoolers learn an Aboriginal language
stories.summary: Curtin University researchers mixed traditional 'yarning' storytelling with songs and play to teach Noongar to preschoolers. The children joined in more actively and confidently.
stories.why: It could help keep endangered languages alive in the next generation.

stories.headline: Two NYPD officers saved a choking baby, then met him again
stories.summary: Flagged down by a frantic mum, Officer Julio Arias gave an unconscious 11-month-old back blows until he cried and breathed again. The boy later visited the precinct to say thanks.
stories.why: Seconds of calm skill gave a family their baby back.
